mapper.insert: insert into booknest.`category`(id, name, icon, parent_id, sort_order, description, status, owner_id, audit_status, reject_reason, create_time) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{icon}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{description}, #{status}, #{ownerId}, #{auditStatus}, #{rejectReason}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select c.*, u.username as owner_name, u.avatar as owner_avatar from booknest.`category` c left join booknest.`user` u on u.id = c.owner_id order by c.sort_order asc, c.name asc
select c.*, u.username as owner_name, u.avatar as owner_avatar from booknest.`category` c left join booknest.`user` u on u.id = c.owner_id where c.owner_id = #{ownerId} order by c.create_time desc
mapper.update: update booknest.`category` set audit_status = #{auditStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, status = case when #{auditStatus} = 1 then 1 else status end, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select category_id as categoryId, count(*) as postCount from booknest.`post` where category_id is not null and audit_status = 1 and status = 1 group by category_id
